props.name: onClick
props.reason: adico extension gap: adico's on_select callback (fires with the item's value on click/Enter/Space, and always closes the menu) already covers item activation with a different, adico-idiomatic shape; a raw onClick handler or a closeOnClick toggle for it has no separate adico equivalent, and isn't planned since on_select already serves the same purpose
